details:
- CVE-2026-105840: reject absolute path names in restricted mode in lrz
  (received files) and lsz (sent files), not only in PUBDIR builds
- CVE-2026-105841: remove the pipe mode that ran received files through a
  shell command when lrz was invoked as rzCOMMAND
- CVE-2026-105842: allocate the received path name with strdup() instead of
  a fixed PATH_MAX*2 buffer, and NUL-terminate the ZFILE subpacket
